input.lugar: Bávaro beach, Punta Cana, Dominican Republic
input.escena: the long curve of pale sand with the line of leaning palm trees toward the sea and calm turquoise water; a woman traveler walks along the waterline at medium distance with the water at her feet. It must read as arriving in the Dominican Caribbean, not a resort advertisement
input.clima: clear sky with isolated low clouds, abundant tropical light, open shadows, sand highlights retained
input.primerPlano: a fallen dry palm frond lying on the sand
input.refLugar: Bávaro beach: the shape of its shoreline, the palm line and the colour of its water
input.prohibir: identifiable resort facades or wristbands, branded sun loungers, invented sargassum, unreal water colour
input.extra: COMPOSITION, MEASURED: the palm line and the woman walking (small, head to feet between 22% and 48% of the frame height, between 42% and 58% of the width) sit in the upper half; the waterline crosses at about 48%. The lower half is calm wet sand and the out-of-focus palm frond, mid-tone, never bright white sand. SKY BRANDLIFT CONSISTENCY (Daniela Ferreira, SKY Blog visual system, sheet 15): believable traveler POV at eye height; luminous natural light with open shadows and whites that keep detail; natural colour where ochres, blues and skin keep their true tones, moderate contrast, no filter, no orange-teal grade, no HDR; real optical depth: the near element very out of focus with soft optical bokeh, the subject sharp; a spontaneous everyday moment, no pose. LENS: 28–35 mm equivalent, contextual and immersive.
